name: Steel and Sling Folding Outdoor Patio Armchair
description: This versatile patio armchair feature a foldable, portable design for easy storage and transport to beaches, campgrounds, parks, and outdoor events. The seating and backing are crafted with black, ventilated, fade-resistant sling fabric, and the black frames are constructed of powder-coated, corrosion-resistant steel for longevity. The sleek, minimalistic look of the all-season, all-weather chairs complements most outdoor furniture and decor. Perfect for any age group. Relax peacefully, enjoy a pleasant chat with someone special, or have fun at an outdoor event with this Steel and Sling Folding Outdoor Patio Armchair
